notes: WArmy 0.4.30 — R233 acceptance round: decision-card dedupe contract restored and made safe by card kind (choice cards dedupe by title while pending, exactly the original anti-spam contract; authorization cards keep strict kind+body+options matching so a pending approval is never reused for a different target or option set). Full-feature acceptance now runs every gate with per-round varying test data (names/text/numbers change each round via a shared variant library, gate order deterministically shuffled, round 1 identical to the historical baseline) and passed three consecutive clean rounds: 90 gates + cross-file unit invariants per round, zero failures, zero flakes (FULL_VERIFY_3X_PASSED). Test-harness hardening behind that result: stray installed-app processes holding probe CDP ports are now cleaned (only debug-port instances, never the user app), 26 gates pre-create their temp profile so the main process truly isolates them, first-run target verification fails fast instead of silently attaching to a wrong app, and the desktop probe deletes before opening files (an open editor could lock the file against the recycle bin). Carries all R232 features unchanged: self-evolve A/B with objective auto-merge, authorized real desktop ops with result animations, VRM runtime, 2D sculpt, voice card read-out, capability lattice enforcement, on-demand TripoSR (MIT, verified sha256).
